answer: A column of basalt cools only under steady heat, so tenure must be earned then re-earned. Each identity needs two holders outside its own cluster to countersign its column, and one countersignature backs one identity, so n aliases need n distinct witnesses rather than a single cooperative crew. Every column is priced by rank: the k-th column an operator files costs k squared in bond, so a farm pays near n cubed. A zephyr audit re-walks a random column each epoch, and standing toward the zenith tier survives only while every claim replays.
